title.narrative: Inception Phase of Cooperation between Swedish and Albania Tax Authority
Inception Phase of cooperation between Swedish and Albanian Tax Authorities

description.narrative: Skatteverket (SKV) har överlämnat ett projektförslag till ambassaden i Tirana för en inledningsfas av samarbete mellan SKV och Generaldirektoratet för skatter (GDT) Albanien. Projektet genomförs som uppföljning till den redan genomförda förberedelsefasen. Under förberedelsefasen identifierades några preliminära områden för vidare dialog och peer to peer-utbyte under inledningsfasen. Detta för att bedöma behoven och utforma ett långsiktigt samarbete

The Swedish Tax Agency (STA) has submitted to the Embassy in Tirana a project proposal for an Inception Phase of Cooperation between the STA and General Directorate of Taxes (GDT) Albania. The proposal follows the fact- finding phase. During the fact finding phase some preliminary areas were identified for further dialogue and peer to peer exchanges in the inception phase to assess the needs and design of the longer-term cooperation.

This intervention intends to assess in more details the needs of the General Directorate of Taxes (GDT) Albania in capacity building in areas already identified in the fact-finding mission or propose new areas for cooperation possible for STA to support. The objectives for the Inception Phase are to: - Establish a Project Management structure for a future development project and start up activities within the prioritized areas - Establish the experts from the STA and GDT into well-functioning teams - Produce a draft Project Proposal for a future development project.

The overall results for the Inception Phase were: - A project management structure for the longer cooperation project was established. - The six areas of cooperation included in the project were more specifically elaborated during the inception phase. Through the short term missions and exchanges of both STA and GDT experts were shared information about working processes within GDT and STA, explored the needs of capacity development for GDT in each area. - During the Inception Phase, altogether the six areas have completed 15 physical missions in Albania and 28 digital missions/meetings. - A Project Proposal for a future three-year capacity development project was drafted and discussed among partners.
In addition, recommendations and support to some processes was initiated, for example for the drafting of the Tax Payers Strategy at GDT. STA has closely coordinated with other donors project working in the fiscal area.
The areas explore were 1) Taxpayers Service 2) Compliance Risk Management 3) Audit & Tax Investigation 4) Building a strong integrity culture; 5) Business Process Management, and 6) International Exchange of Information.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
